'''Tinray''' was one of the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentices]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and served under Malgus on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].
